status: FROZEN DRAFT -- final once decisions D1 and D2 are made; record this file's SHA-256 before Phase 3
primary_test: TEST_PRIMARY_JOINT (t_h in {4,8} x p in {0.6,0.85}, unseen seeds), all training templates
statistics: 95% cluster-bootstrap CIs over trajectories, 2000 resamples; per test family, never pooled; pre-onset and post-onset reported separately.

baselines: mean by candidate x decision tick
heuristic-outcome-as-prediction (d(s)'s realized outcome for every candidate)
outcome_prediction.criterion: On the primary test, pinball loss (averaged over the three quantiles) on future_T100 and future_unmet is lower than the best baseline, with the paired-difference CI excluding 0; upper-quantile coverage within 0.9 +/- 0.05.
outcome_prediction.irreducible_floor: report the within-identical-input spread (Bayes floor proxy) next to every error; the model is judged against baselines, not against zero error

metrics: outcome-equivalence with the BASE2_298 oracle-best class
T100 and unmet regret vs oracle-best
recommendation.criterion: Outcome-equivalence rate greater than d(s)'s own, CI excluding 0, on states where some candidate strictly beats d(s). Exact oracle-action match: diagnostic only.

safety.criterion: Harmful-recommendation rate: upper 95% CI bound <= 1% of decisions in every test family.
safety.derivation: 1% is a safety requirement, not fitted to data. With zero observed harms the rule-of-three bound needs >= 300 independent deviating decisions; trajectory clustering raises this, which sets the TEST_PRIMARY_JOINT size (40 seeds x 4 cells x 6 templates = 960 trajectories).

generalization.criterion: Prediction + recommendation + safety all pass on D.

closed_loop.criterion: Safety: P4 strictly worse than P2 in <= 1% of paired episodes (upper CI). Usefulness: NO threshold is justified yet -- the minimum meaningful gain will be set from the Phase-1 pilot (spread between P2 and P5) BEFORE Phase 3 and appended here with its hash.

content.primary_test_family: D_joint_timing_x_compliance on the new-data design (held-out t_h AND held-out p, disjoint seeds). With existing data only family A is possible; any such result must be labeled in-distribution.
content.statistics: 95% cluster-bootstrap CIs resampling TRAJECTORIES (not rows), 2000 resamples; every criterion reported per test family, never pooled.

prediction_success.question: Does the model predict action outcomes better than simple baselines?
prediction_success.criterion: MAE on T100 and on post-decision total unmet each below the BEST non-learning baseline with the paired-difference CI excluding 0; T90 and hazard-edge unmet reported, not gated; upper-quantile coverage within +/-5 points of nominal.

recommendation_success.question: Does the selector choose actions whose realized outcomes are close to the oracle's?
metrics: outcome-equivalence rate (realized vector == oracle-best vector over the SAME candidate set)
regret in T100 and post-decision unmet vs the oracle-best candidate
oracle-advantage capture on states where the oracle strictly beats d(s)
recommendation_success.criterion: Outcome-equivalence rate above d(s)'s own rate with CI excluding 0 on states where a strict improvement exists. Exact oracle-action match is diagnostic only.

safety_success.question: Does the AI-assisted policy avoid harmful recommendations?
safety_success.harmful_definition: Realized outcome strictly worse than d(s) under the established 4-criterion order (one-step counterfactual from the same state).
safety_success.criterion: Harmful-recommendation rate upper 95% CI bound <= 1% in every test family, and no recommendation raises post-decision hazard-edge unmet by more than dH.

families.E_template_zero_shot: diagnostic, expected hard, never a gate

generalization_success.criterion: Prediction, recommendation and safety criteria all met on D; A-C and E reported with the same metrics.

closed_loop_success.question: Executed at every decision, is evacuation at least as good and as safe as the deterministic baseline?
closed_loop_success.protocol: Full-episode rollouts on the primary test cells with common random numbers (same seeds / compliance vectors) for the AI-assisted and d(s)-only policies. A SEPARATE run: training labels are one-step counterfactuals with heuristic continuation (target audit T6).
closed_loop_success.criterion: Non-inferiority: paired T100 difference upper 95% CI bound <= 0.5 tick; paired hazard-edge unmet difference upper bound <= dH; no episode with lower completion rate than d(s).

explicitly_not_success_criteria: Beating the heuristic is NOT required: recommendation quality is measured against the oracle over the same candidate set, safety against d(s).
Exact oracle-action match is NOT required (diagnostic only).
Any result obtained with a feature classified D, E, F or G does not count.
